name: funnel chart
description: A funnel chart is a special type of visualization chart used to show the flow of data through different stages in a business process. It is named for its funnel-like shape, displaying the data volume of each stage from top to bottom, usually wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, reflecting the process of data loss or conversion. Funnel charts are particularly suitable for visualizing conversion rates in business processes, such as sales funnels, user registration flows, or marketing funnels. With a funnel chart, you can intuitively observe data changes at each stage and identify key conversion points or bottlenecks. Each layer of the funnel chart represents a stage in the process, and the width or area of the layer is usually proportional to the data volume of that stage, thus clearly reflecting the data loss during the conversion process.

data.description: Data for funnel chart, such as, [{ category: '浏览网站', value: 50000 }, { category: '放入购物车', value: 35000 }, { category: '生成订单', value: 25000 }, { category: '支付订单', value: 15000 }, { category: '完成交易', value: 8000 }].

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.

theme.description: Set the theme for the chart, optional, default is 'default'.

style.description: Style configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the chart, such as, '#fff'.

palette.description: Color palette for the chart, it is a collection of colors.

texture.description: Set the texture for the chart, optional, default is 'default'. 'rough' refers to hand-drawn style.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.
